sources: recreation.gov public search API per-site catalog for facility 234486 (catx.py), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Single site $22 a night per camping unit (most sites hold two units, each charged); $5 a night per extra vehicle, paid at the campground (cash or check).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234486/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-06: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night', 'Extra Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle') + recreation.gov notices (fee per camping unit), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234486 ('There are no electricity or sewer hookups at the campground.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground (same), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: 38 individual sites (24 reservable, 14 walk-up) plus a group site; the Forest Service page says 40 individual sites. Gravel, dirt or grass parking; the catalog gives 48 ft for the sites that list a length (most list none). Two loops, Bay and Larch.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234486 ('Holland Lake Campground has 38 rentable sites, 24 of which are reservable and 14 for walk-up visitors') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Max Vehicle Length 48 on 7 individual sites, none listed on the rest) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground ('40 individual sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush toilets in one loop only, and for 2026 the Bay Loop's flushing restrooms are closed (portable restrooms supplied). The RV dump station, about 1/4 mile from the campground, is closed for the 2026 season. Boat ramp with trailer parking.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided', 'Flush Toilet in one loop', 'there is a dump station within 1/4 mile of the campground') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234486 (notice: 'For the 2026 season ... portable restrooms for the Bay Loop area where flushing restrooms are closed. The RV dump station will be closed this season but potable water will be available.'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use: Mid May - Late September'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 24 of the 38 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 14 walk-up. A reserved site is held only until 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234486 (overview: '24 of which are reservable and 14 for walk-up visitors. The stay limit is 16 consecutive days'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; notices) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/holland-lake-campground ('16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF campground on the NW shore of Holland Lake in the Swan Valley (Swan Lake RD), run in summer by concessionaire Big Sky Recreation Company. Some sites close to the lake, others further back or higher on the bank; gravel beaches and the Holland Falls National Recreation Trail trailhead nearby. --Claude
summary: Concession-run (Big Sky Recreation Company) for the Forest Service; partly reservable on recreation.gov, partly walk-up. Confirmed $22 (2026), no electric, 38 sites, 48-ft max, reservable, 16-night limit; added sewer none, fcfs some_sites, vault + flush toilets (Bay Loop flush closed 2026), potable water, season mid May - late September. Not stated: booking window (inherited 180); the soft 1-night minimum is no rule. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov says the campground is 'located on the shores of Holland Lake', 'some sites close to the 416-acre lake', and lists Lake Access and Beach Access; the entry is lakeview.
